sports.headline: Kimi Antonelli becomes F1's youngest-ever world champion as Verstappen wins Mexico City GP
sports.summary: Antonelli, 20 years and 68 days old, clinched his maiden title with third place in Mexico City, in his second F1 season. Max Verstappen won the race for Red Bull, his sixth win at the circuit and his third in four races. Lewis Hamilton was second after taking his first pole for Ferrari. Hamilton also called for serious talks within Ferrari after Charles Leclerc's penalty cost the team a likely one-two.

sports.headline: Arsenal win at Anfield for the first time in 14 years to go top of the Premier League
sports.summary: Kai Havertz's first-half goal gave Arsenal a 1-0 win at Liverpool, their first at Anfield in 14 years, and took them to the top of the table. It came five days after a League Cup exit to fourth-tier opposition. Man City have now lost two league games in a row.

sports.headline: Australia's Jillaroos set women's rugby league record with 124-6 World Cup win over Wales
sports.summary: Australia scored 21 tries in the win, the biggest margin ever in a women's rugby league international. Jaime Chapman scored six tries, which equals the women's international record. The previous margin record was France's 116-0 win over Serbia in 2023. The source is a live-updates page that carries a match report entry.

sports.headline: Almgren wins NYC Marathon on debut in 50th-anniversary race; Chepkirui takes women's title
sports.summary: Sweden's Andreas Almgren won in 2:06:01, the third-fastest time in the race's 50-year history. He is the first runner to win the event on debut since 2010. Sheila Chepkirui won the women's race, and American Jess McClain was second. That made her the first American woman on the NYC podium since Shalane Flanagan in 2018.

fashion.headline: Travis Scott's Cactus Jack, Rockstar Games and Nike plan three Air Force 1 Low GTA 6 colourways for 19 November
fashion.summary: Sole Retriever reports three Air Force 1 '07 colourways tied to GTA 6's global launch day, priced at $130. The report also mentions a possible four-way tie-in with the Miami Heat's Vice City night on 18 November, which it presents as likely rather than confirmed. Treat as a sneaker-culture story. The report appears to lean on social-media leaks, so confirm with Nike before running it.

marketing.headline: Marketing leadership moves: Amex CMO to retire, Beast Industries names first CMO, Diageo North America and Liquid I.V. hire
marketing.summary: Adweek's roundup covers American Express CMO Elizabeth Rutledge, who retires in March 2027 after more than 30 years. MrBeast's Beast Industries has promoted a Molson Coors veteran to its first CMO. Diageo North America has named Sebnem Erim CMO. Liquid I.V. has hired Poppi's former CMO Jenny Danzi (Campaign reported that move on 30 October). Popeyes CMO Matt Rubin is leaving less than a year into the role. The roundup's date is inferred from the site's '2 days ago' label.

marketing.headline: Sainsbury's brings back the BFG for a third Christmas ad as it shifts spend away from TV
marketing.summary: Sainsbury's is sticking with the Roald Dahl character as its proven brand asset. It plans to divert more spend from TV and to 'rewire' its marketing department in 2027. Campaign covered the creative; Marketing Week covered the strategy.

marketing.headline: John Lewis teases its Christmas 2026 ad
marketing.summary: Campaign reports John Lewis has started teasing its Christmas campaign, which is one of the best-known in UK retail marketing.
